verdict.rationale: A Secretary of State business-filing service could plausibly publish a public data API, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API endpoints, a key-issuance path, or rate limits. The cited pages describe only human-facing Gateway portal tips, OHID sign-in, and tax filing tools, and the probes show ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning 403 at robots.txt, so no API documentation could be found on the Secretary of State's own pages.
